description: This file provides support for the Meta Llama API's compatibility with OpenAI API parameters. It defines a class `LlamaAPIConfig` that inherits from `OpenAIGPTConfig`, overriding methods to specify supported parameters and how to map them, particularly handling the limited support for certain OpenAI features in the Llama API.

classes.name: LlamaAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Llama API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig to customize OpenAI parameter support and mapping.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for the Llama API, indicating limited support for certain features.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to the format expected by Llama API, removing unsupported parameters like non-json response formats.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
